attempts.note: T1 both opponents Protected (Wailord's blocked Fake Out + Thunderbolt). T2 Wailord fired full-HP Water Spout (130 on Rillaboom) but Wood Hammer OHKOed it first; the AI withdrew Seaking for Drapion, which ate the redirected Thunderbolt and was OHKOed (238 HP, ~241-284 damage). T3 Seaking Protect blocked Grassy Glide; Morpeko crit Crunch 142. T4 Grassy Glide OHKOed Seaking; Hangry Aura Wheel KOed the 68-HP Rillaboom. T5 Morpeko Protect blocked Sacred Sword + Draco Meteor; T6 Sacred Sword ended it.

cooler: The cannon idea works.
